name: openvino
description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
one_liner: Intel's toolkit for making AI models run fast on ordinary computer chips instead of needing expensive specialized hardware.
buyer: A hardware or embedded-systems company that wants to ship AI features (like camera object detection) on cheap devices without a GPU.
business_use_cases: A security-camera manufacturer uses it to run person-detection AI directly on the camera's chip, cutting cloud costs.
A retail-analytics vendor deploys in-store people-counting AI on existing store PCs instead of buying new GPU servers.
A systems integrator charges manufacturers to optimize and deploy their AI models onto Intel-based edge devices.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid consulting service that optimizes clients' existing AI models to run efficiently on edge hardware with this toolkit.

steal_this: This is a dev-only optimization library, not an end-user product — the only realistic move is offering 'make your AI model run 3x cheaper on CPU' as a paid consulting gig.
